# The Ultimate Ice Cream Experience® Made Fresh Daily

At Cold Stone Creamery®, every creation starts with premium [ice cream](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/ice-cream/) made fresh in our stores. Customize your treat with candy, cookies, fruit, nuts, and other favorite mix-ins, all folded together on our signature frozen granite stone.

## Limited-Time Favorites

 [Cake Full of Things](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/cake-full-of-things/) [The Cat in the Hat's Cotton Candy Catastrophe](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/the-cat-in-the-hats-cotton-candy-catastrophe/) [Boo Batter™ Ice Cream Taco](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/boo-batter-ice-cream-taco/) [Treat or Treat™](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/treat-or-treat/) [Witches’ Boo](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/witches-boo/) [Going Bananas for JELL-O® Pudding](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/going-bananas-for-jell-o-pudding/) [Crumb and Get It](https://www.coldstonecreamery.com/menu/limited-time-offers/crumb-and-get-it/)
